Fields.Name: Knee Axis
Fields.Description: The axis the knee bends around, in the knee's space.

Fields.Name: Foot End
Fields.Description: The end of the foot (the toe), in the ankle's space.

Fields.Name: Use Foot End To Only Heel Ray
Fields.Description: Whether only the heel ray is used for the foot end.

Fields.Name: Use Always Continuous
Fields.Description: Whether the foot's ground is always tracked continuously.

Fields.Name: Foot Planted Ankle Height
Fields.Description: The ankle's height above the ground when the foot is planted, in model space.

Fields.Name: Foot Raised Ankle Height
Fields.Description: The ankle's height above the ground when the foot is raised, in model space.

Fields.Name: Max Ankle Height
Fields.Description: The highest the ankle can be raised, in model space.

Fields.Name: Min Ankle Height
Fields.Description: The lowest the ankle can go, in model space.

Fields.Name: Max Foot Pitch
Fields.Description: The most the foot can pitch, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Min Foot Pitch
Fields.Description: The least the foot can pitch, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Max Foot Roll
Fields.Description: The most the foot can roll, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Min Foot Roll
Fields.Description: The least the foot can roll, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Heel Offset From Ankle
Fields.Description: Where the heel is, from the ankle.

Fields.Name: Favor Toe Interpenetration Over Steep Slope
Fields.Description: How much the toe may sink into steep ground rather than the foot tilting fully.

Fields.Name: Favor Heel Interpenetration Over Steep Slope
Fields.Description: How much the heel may sink into steep ground rather than the foot tilting fully.

Fields.Name: Max Knee Angle
Fields.Description: The most the knee can bend, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Min Knee Angle
Fields.Description: The least the knee can bend, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Hip Bone
Fields.Description: The leg's hip bone.

Fields.Name: Hip Sibling Bone
Fields.Description: A bone that follows the hip (such as a twist bone). -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Knee Bone
Fields.Description: The leg's knee bone.

Fields.Name: Knee Sibling Bone
Fields.Description: A bone that follows the knee. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Ankle Bone
Fields.Description: The leg's ankle bone.
